import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_SIZE = 2000005;
    static int edgeCount, startNode, endNode, totalNodes, totalEdges, kParam, cParam, dParam;
    static int[] nexts = new int[MAX_SIZE], headList = new int[MAX_SIZE], target = new int[MAX_SIZE], capacity = new int[MAX_SIZE], weights = new int[MAX_SIZE], currentEdge = new int[MAX_SIZE], xVals = new int[MAX_SIZE], yVals = new int[MAX_SIZE], visitedFlags = new int[MAX_SIZE], distArray = new int[MAX_SIZE];
    static Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
    static int nodes; // total nodes in the problem, as per original code's context

    static void addLink(int u, int v, int cap, int wght) {
        nexts[++edgeCount] = headList[u];
        headList[u] = edgeCount;
        target[edgeCount] = v;
        capacity[edgeCount] = cap;
        weights[edgeCount] = wght;
        nexts[++edgeCount] = headList[v];
        headList[v] = edgeCount;
        target[edgeCount] = u;
        capacity[edgeCount] = 0;
        weights[edgeCount] = -wght;
    }

    static boolean spfa() {
        Arrays.fill(distArray, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        q.clear();
        q.add(startNode);
        distArray[startNode] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            visitedFlags[u] = 0;
            for (int i = headList[u]; i != 0; i = nexts[i]) {
                if (capacity[i] > 0 && distArray[target[i]] > distArray[u] + weights[i]) {
                    distArray[target[i]] = distArray[u] + weights[i];
                    if (visitedFlags[target[i]] == 0) {
                        visitedFlags[target[i]] = 1;
                        q.add(target[i]);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return distArray[endNode] <= 1000000000;
    }

    static int dfs(int u, int flowIn) {
        int totalFlow = 0;
        visitedFlags[u] = 1;
        if (u == endNode) return flowIn;
        for (int i = currentEdge[u]; i != 0; i = nexts[i]) {
            if (visitedFlags[target[i]] == 0 && capacity[i] > 0 && distArray[target[i]] == distArray[u] + weights[i]) {
                int flowBottle = Math.min(flowIn, capacity[i]);
                flowBottle = Math.min(flowIn, dfs(target[i], flowBottle));
                if (flowBottle > 0) {
                    capacity[i] -= flowBottle;
                    capacity[i ^ 1] += flowBottle;
                    totalFlow += flowBottle;
                    flowIn -= flowBottle;
                    if (flowIn == 0) break;
                }
            }
        }
        return totalFlow;
    }

    static int gao() {
        int totalFlow = 0;
        while (spfa()) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= totalNodes + kParam; i++) {
                currentEdge[i] = headList[i];
            }
            totalFlow += dfs(startNode, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        }
        return totalFlow;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        totalNodes = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        totalEdges = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        kParam = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        cParam = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        dParam = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        startNode = 0;
        endNode = 1;
        edgeCount = 1;

        // Read x values
        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int[] xInput = new int[totalEdges + 1];
        for (int i = 1; i <= totalEdges; i++) {
            xInput[i] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        }

        // Read y values
        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int[] yInput = new int[totalEdges + 1];
        for (int i = 1; i <= totalEdges; i++) {
            yInput[i] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        }

        // Add links from start node to initial x positions
        for (int i = 1; i <= kParam; i++) {
            int x = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
            addLink(startNode, x + 1, 1, 0);
        }

        // Build the graph
        int n = totalNodes;
        nodes = totalNodes; // for clarity
        for (int i = 0; i <= totalNodes + kParam; i++) {
            addLink(2 + i * totalNodes, endNode, kParam, 0);
            if (i == totalNodes + kParam) break;
            for (int j = 1; j <= totalEdges; j++) {
                for (int l = kParam; l >= 0; l--) {
                    int fromX = xInput[j] + 1 + i * totalNodes;
                    int fromY = yInput[j] + 1 + i * totalNodes;
                    int toX = fromX;
                    int toY = fromY;
                    int capacityVal = 1;
                    int weightVal = (l * 2 + 1) * dParam + cParam;
                    addLink(fromX, fromY, capacityVal, weightVal);
                    addLink(fromY, nodes + fromX, capacityVal, weightVal);
                }
            }
            for (int j = 1; j <= totalNodes; j++) {
                int from = j + 1 + i * totalNodes;
                int to = j + 1 + i * totalNodes + n;
                addLink(from, to, kParam, cParam);
            }
        }

        System.out.println(gao());
    }
}
